overview_description.description:
Evo.Do is codeless test automation for interactive products and other digital products. The bots are powered by Deep Reinforcement Learning - cleverly applied to the challenges of testing interactive software.

Evo.Do was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
